subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing symbolism and extended metaphor within a literary work
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student traces a recurring object or image through a short text and discusses what larger idea it represents
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a symbol to the abstract concept it represents in a given text
exercise.abstract: Student explains a symbol or extended metaphor in a text and its connection to the work's larger meaning

misconception_flags: identifies a recurring detail but interprets it too literally rather than as symbolic

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
